description: Test helper functions and setup code for team-related unit tests in Mattermost, including configuration setup, user and team management, and mock WebSocket publishing.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for testing team functionalities, managing test context, configuration, and database state.

classes.name: mockWebHub
classes.description: Mock implementation of a WebSocket hub for testing publish events.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including database and configuration setup.

methods.name: setupTestHelper
methods.description: Creates a test helper with a temporary workspace and configured store for testing.

methods.name: CreateUser
methods.description: Creates and saves a new user in the test database.

methods.name: DeleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user from the test database.

methods.name: DeleteTeam
methods.description: Deletes a team and related data from the test database.
